title: hackathon-index
description: Past hackathons, their winners and a sample of non-winners. Non-winners are a capped sample, so compare winners with non-winners from the same event (the traits table does).

projects.description: Every tagged project from A and B events. Scores are relative to other projects from the same event, scored side by side.

events.description: Every event with its LLM grade (A-D), quality score and prize split.

traits.description: Within-event gap: how much more often winners have the trait than non-winners from the same event, in percentage points.

builders.description: Devpost profiles with at least one winning project. Wins are complete; entries are only those we fetched.

what_wins.title: What wins (A and B events)
what_wins.description: Traits winners have more often than non-winners from the same event.
what_wins.sql: SELECT trait, value, within_event_gap, winner_rate, nonwinner_rate, projects, events FROM traits WHERE scope = 'A and B' AND projects >= 50 ORDER BY within_event_gap DESC LIMIT 40

what_loses.title: What loses (A and B events)
what_loses.description: Traits non-winners have more often than winners from the same event.
what_loses.sql: SELECT trait, value, within_event_gap, winner_rate, nonwinner_rate, projects, events FROM traits WHERE scope = 'A and B' AND projects >= 50 ORDER BY within_event_gap ASC LIMIT 40

technologies.title: Technologies by win gap
technologies.sql: SELECT value AS technology, within_event_gap, winner_rate, nonwinner_rate, projects, events FROM traits WHERE scope = 'A and B' AND trait = 'built_with' ORDER BY within_event_gap DESC

winners_using.title: Winners built with a technology
winners_using.description: Type a technology as Devpost lists it, e.g. gemini, langchain, supabase.
winners_using.sql: SELECT title, url, event, grade, year, prizes, summary, combined, video_url, repo_url FROM projects WHERE won = 1 AND (',' || lower(replace(built_with, ', ', ',')) || ',') LIKE '%,' || lower(:tech) || ',%' ORDER BY grade, combined DESC

top_builders.title: Top builders by wins
top_builders.sql: SELECT username, profile_url, wins_ab, wins_all, projects_fetched, events, winning_projects FROM builders ORDER BY wins_ab DESC, wins_all DESC LIMIT 100

best_events.title: Best events to learn from
best_events.sql: SELECT title, url, grade, quality, year, event_type, cash_usd, submissions, tagged_projects, grade_reason FROM events WHERE grade IN ('A', 'B') ORDER BY quality DESC
